title: Load moved fixtures exactly as javac read them

cases.says: a JSON fixture with CRLF line endings, an escape and relative indentation loads with LF endings, the escape interpreted and the indentation kept
a fixture whose closing delimiter followed its last line loads without a final line break
Unicode escapes become their characters, and an escaped backslash from one then starts an ordinary escape
spaces kept by \s and carriage returns written as \r are in the loaded value
a backslash written as \\ before a u stays a backslash followed by the letters
a line break written as a Unicode escape starts a new line before the indentation is measured

origin.section: translateEscapes() Interprets Escapes in a String That Arrives at Run Time
